review_evidence: Directory survey: 244 Complex, 124 Contour, 64 Calculus, 63 SpecialFunctions, 58 Semigroups, 49 Sobolev, 43 Normed, 43 CompletelyMonotone, 42 InnerProductSpace, 38 PDE, 36 PositiveDefinite, 25 Fredholm, other subdirectories 1-13 files; every file ends in .lean.

Declaration grep: 7 of 904 files have no declaration. Read in full: Complex/Conformal/Reflection.lean, Complex/Conformal/Reflection/Circle.lean, Complex/Conformal/Removability.lean, Contour/WorkedExamples/HalfDisc.lean, Semigroups/BoundedGenerator.lean, Semigroups/Defs.lean, Semigroups/Generator.lean. Each holds `module`, public imports of TauCeti submodules, and (in 6 of 7) a docstring that names the mathematics re-exported (Schwarz reflection, Painleve removability, half-disc contour, C0-semigroup generators). These are import aggregators and FILTER-007 keeps them primary-eligible.
Read the smallest declaration files in full: Normed/Algebra/Basic.lean (local instance normedAlgebraRatOfReal) and Real/Sqrt.lean (theorem Real.inv_sqrt_mul_sq); both are real formal content.

Largest files checked: CompletelyMonotone/Bernstein/Measures.lean (76468 bytes, 76 declarations, Chafai approximating measures for Bernstein theorem) and PDE/EnergyForm/Sobolev.lean (59250 bytes, 53 declarations, Garding inequality); hand-written Lean, not data dumps.

Sampled the first file of each subdirectory (for example Bochner/BochnerTheorem.lean 20 decls, Holder/Algebra.lean 40, PositiveDefinite/AddGroup.lean 46, Semigroups/Basic.lean 38); all have declarations.

grep -w sorry: 1 hit, Complex/Conformal/Reflection/Principle.lean line 15, inside a docstring reference, not a proof placeholder. grep for auto-generated/ChatGPT/as an AI/do not edit markers: 0 files.
summary: Surveyed all 904 listed files under TauCeti/Analysis (25 subdirectories; all .lean, 261 to 76468 bytes, all present in the checkout). A declaration grep with Lean modifiers found 897 files with theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/abbrev/inductive declarations. The 7 files without declarations are public-import re-export modules with module docstrings; I read all 7 completely. Under FILTER-007 such modules keep their module identity in primary search (FD-016 ranking, not filtering), so they stay. No file holds generated, transcript, placeholder, or non-mathematical content. Disposition: retain all.
